title: Mini SOS Daily Barrier Recovery Cream

specifications.ingredientPreferences: nonComedogenic, crueltyFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, hyaluronicAcid, fragranceFree

descriptionHtml:
✓ allure 2024 Best of Beauty Award Winner✓ Hyaluronic Acid✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Fragrance Free✓ Non-Comedogenic

fWhat it is: An intentionally basic travel size daily moisturizer designed for sensitive skin. Instantly hydrates, soothes irritation and helps reinforce the skin barrier.


Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily


Skincare Concerns: Uneven Texture, Redness, and Dryness


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Hyaluronic Acid: A blend of four types to intensely hydrate and visibly plump skin.

- Ceramides: Support and replenish the skin barrier.

- Allantoin: Locks in moisture and soothes irritation.


Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, phthalates, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Use AM and PM to face and neck as the last step of your skincare routine.
-Layer with SOS Spray + SOS Serum (each sold separately) for the best skin-soothing results.
-For extra dry or flaky skin, add your favorite oil on top.
Ingredients+
-Hyaluronic Acid: A blend of four types to intensely hydrate and visibly plump skin.
-Ceramides: Support and replenish the skin barrier.
-Allantoin: Locks in moisture and soothes irritation.

Water/Aqua/Eau, Glycerin, Cetyl Ethylhexanoate, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Propanediol, 1,2-Hexanediol, Glyceryl Stearate, Cetearyl Alcohol, Microcrystalline Cellulose, Sodium Polyacrylate Starch, Sclerotium Gum, Triolein, Potassium Cetyl Phosphate, Behenyl Alcohol, Allantoin, Ceramide NP, Glyceryl Dioleate, Cellulose Gum, Sodium Phytate, Pentylene Glycol, Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate, Sodium Hyaluronate, Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer, Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate, Ethylhexylglycerin.
